description: Synthetic evaluation inputs and checker expectations, not captured agent outputs. Keep expectations outside the audited workspace.

cases.input: Compare these supplied synthetic reports only. report-baseline: 20 completed comparable requests, 80 logical tool calls. report-candidate: 40 completed requests of the same workload mix, 120 logical tool calls. Reports explicitly match permissions, data/freshness, policy, cache, model/settings, provider/concurrency and counting semantics; only redundant read removal changes. Quality and safety margins are not evaluated. Cite the supplied report labels, do not inspect source or traces.

Compare supplied synthetic reports only. report-baseline: 20 requests, 80 logical tool calls, cold cache. report-candidate: 20 requests, 40 logical tool calls, warm cache and changed authorization policy. Quality is not supplied. Both use the same scenario label. No source or trace access.

Compare supplied synthetic report-baseline and report-candidate only. Both cover 20 completed identical requests with matched conditions and counting semantics. Baseline has zero logical tool calls; candidate has 20. Quality evidence is absent. Do not fetch code or traces.

Compare supplied synthetic report-baseline and report-candidate only. Matching scenario and request coverage; baseline total input tokens are unknown because failed-attempt usage is missing. Candidate total input is 1000 tokens. No additional evidence is available.

Compare two supplied synthetic audits only. report-baseline has a demonstrated duplicate retrieval finding. report-candidate omits that finding, but inspected a different narrower path and provides no evidence about the duplicate mechanism. No source or traces are available.

Review only supplied synthetic source and contract. Source ctx.py:1-4 is:
def assemble(segment):
    messages = [segment, segment]
    return messages

The contract states segment is an unchanged authorized immutable evidence segment with 100 recorded tokens under the same tokenizer. Assembly at line 2 is the only consumer, a single occurrence satisfies the schema and all quality/safety/citation requirements, and insertion has no side effects. One model call consumes the result. Report static conditional savings, not measured output quality.

Review supplied synthetic segment metadata only: selection-a and selection-b share document ID doc-1 but refer to versions v1 and v2 under different freshness states. Tokens are known but equivalence, consumers and quality of deduplication are not. Do not fetch document text.

Review supplied synthetic retrieval record selection-a: 10 selected documents and a configured top-k of 50. Only two documents are cited in the answer, but hidden validation/consumer evidence is unavailable. Tokenizer and token counts are unknown; text length is 4000 characters. Do not fetch passages or prompts.

Review supplied synthetic policies only. outer-policy wraps every failed SDK operation with at most 2 total attempts. sdk-policy executes at most 3 total transport attempts on each outer invocation. Source contracts establish both layers execute on the all-failure branch with no other retries. There are no runtime records. Recovery requirements and write/read safety are unknown.

Review supplied synthetic policy-a and policy-b: routing selects exactly one branch. Branch A permits 2 total attempts, branch B 3; they never nest. No runtime records or branch frequencies are supplied.

Review supplied synthetic cache-read-a and cache-read-b: identical tool/query text but different tenant/auth scopes and data versions. No cross-tenant reuse contract exists. Cache eligibility and complete hit/miss records are unavailable.

Review supplied synthetic attempts span-a=[0,5) and span-b=[5,10) milliseconds. These are the complete aligned start/end records for the two attempts; no parent dependency is available. The operation classes and runtime admissibility contract are supplied, but no consumption/safe-removal evidence exists.

Review supplied synthetic request-a: an accepted durable write must finish and run required cleanup after client disconnection. job-a has an independent consumer. The source contract establishes this lifecycle is intentional and required. No replay or cancellation is authorized.
